title: The half-life of fame: what happens to our attention after a notable person dies
excerpt: I followed the English Wikipedia articles of 16,397 people who died between 2016 and 2023. In the month of a death the typical article is read 14.9 times as much as usual; two to three years later it is back to 0.98 of its old level. People who died young keep the most.
seo_description: How fast does attention fade after a notable death? 16,397 people followed on English Wikipedia, 2016 to 2026.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'The half-life of fame' beside a red line that spikes at the month of death and slowly falls back to its earlier level.
